notes.subject: ol pikinini bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long ol manmeri — ol i mas tokim ol brata na ol susa bilong ol.

notes.subject: Ami · Rukama
notes.rationale: Nem Ami ('manmeri bilong mi') na Rukama ('meri bilong marimari') i flipim ol nem Lo-Ammi na Lo-Rukama long Stat 1:9.

notes.subject: manmeri bilong mi · meri bilong marimari
notes.rationale: Sapos yu laikim mining i kamap klia, tanim ol nem: 'ol manmeri bilong mi' na 'meri bilong marimari' — tasol ol nem Hibru i winim.

translation: Tokim ol brata bilong yu: Ami; na tokim ol susa bilong yu: Rukama.

tokens.gloss: na long ol susa bilong yu
